title: The Cinematic Threshold
description: A woman in a dark trench coat stands in an ornate, broken golden doorway, one hand on the open door. The left side shows a warm, film-noir interior with scattered film reels and photos on a wooden floor, while the right side reveals a cold, decaying exterior with overgrown vines and mechanical debris. Two cherubic figures with film reels for heads float above, projecting light beams.
prompt: A surreal scene of a woman in a dark trench coat and pearl necklace standing in a massive, cracked golden doorway that splits two realities. Left side is a warm vintage film room with scattered 35mm reels and photos on parquet floor. Right side is a cold decaying mechanical exterior with vines and gears. Two flying cherubs with film projector heads shine beams from above. Dramatic lighting, cinematic atmosphere, intricate details.
